mapper.select: select id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, is_default, create_time from xl_user_address where user_id = #{userId} order by is_default desc, create_time desc
select id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, is_default, create_time from xl_user_address where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into xl_user_address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, is_default, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{isDefault}, now())
mapper.update: update xl_user_address set is_default = 0, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
